name: openbot
description: BlinkyBot: a local-first Mac app for the agent CLIs and API keys you already have. MIT fork of OpenBOT.
author: BlinkyBot contributors

scripts.build: node Scripts/build-speech.mjs && node Scripts/build-native-glass.mjs && electron-vite build
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --import ./scripts/register-ts.mjs --test src/main/store/sessionSegments.test.ts src/main/store/sessionDatabase.test.ts src/main/store/sessionCollection.test.ts src/main/agent/uiAcknowledgement.test.ts src/main/agent/inlineToolBudget.test.ts src/main/store/vault.test.ts src/main/ipc/startTurn.test.ts src/main/agent/cancelFollowup.test.ts src/main/agent/taskContinuation.test.ts src/main/agent/liveMessages.test.ts src/main/agent/resultData.test.ts src/main/agent/memoryPreferences.test.ts src/main/agent/memoryDurability.test.ts src/main/agent/memoryRecall.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/messagePresentation.test.ts src/main/store/messageQueue.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/shortcutRules.test.ts src/main/backends/defaultBackend.test.ts src/main/settingsSchema.test.ts src/main/backends/cli/codexEvents.test.ts src/main/backends/cli/codexThread.test.ts src/main/backends/cli/codexSafety.test.ts src/main/backends/cli/codexElicitation.test.ts src/main/agent/approvalPolicy.test.ts src/main/agent/runtimeMcp.test.ts src/main/backends/cli/printMode.test.ts src/main/native/dataPolicy.test.ts src/main/store/providerBindings.test.ts src/shared/activeConversation.test.ts src/main/backends/cli/codexModels.test.ts src/main/backends/cli/cliImages.test.ts src/main/backends/cli/authStatus.test.ts src/main/backends/cli/kimiEvents.test.ts src/main/backends/cli/kimiModels.test.ts src/main/gateway/tokens.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/botChat.test.ts src/renderer/src/components/imageAttachments.test.ts src/main/store/starterBots.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/backendDetail.test.ts src/shared/botBinding.test.ts src/shared/thinking.test.ts src/shared/fast.test.ts src/main/backends/providerCatalog.test.ts
scripts.test:webhook: npm run build && node Scripts/test-webhook-chat.mjs && BLINKY_TEST_WEBHOOK_BUSY=1 node Scripts/test-webhook-chat.mjs && node Scripts/test-webhook-migration.mjs

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: BlinkyBot needs camera access only if you attach camera input to a bot.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BlinkyBot needs microphone access only if you use voice input.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: BlinkyBot uses AppleScript to let bots control apps on your behalf during computer-use actions.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: BlinkyBot converts speech to text on this Mac only when you start voice input.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: BlinkyBot uses the local network only when you explicitly share a conversation with trusted devices.
